basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 3 DEO, MTS & Other Posts
basic_details.post_name: Scientist-C (Non-Medical), Data Entry Operator (under DHR), Multi-Tasking Staff (under DHR)

age_limit.details: The age limits and reference date are specified below. The age limit is calculated as on or before 30th August 2026.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | scientist-c (non-medical): M.Sc./M.Sc. MLT in Virology/ Microbiology/ Biotechnology/ Parasitology/ M. Tech Biotechnology with 4 Yrs. Exp. In R&D/ Teaching Exp. Or 2nd Class in these Degree with Ph.D with 4 Yrs Exp. | data entry operator (under dhr): i) Graduationii) 8000 keys depression per hour on computer | multi-tasking staff (under dhr): High School/ Matric

salary_details.details: The HRA will be admissible as per the classification of the city where the lab is located. The increment rate will be 5% after every 02 years as per DST norms.

selection_process: The applications received will be scrutinized by the scrutiny committee. Recruitments will be made through an Interview
and a written test will be conducted if the eligible candidates are more than 30 per post. Selection will be based purely on a merit basis.
how_to_apply: Download the application form from the Institute’s website at aiimsdeoghar.edu.in.
Fill in the application format properly and sign it.
Attach two recent self-signed passport-sized color photographs, with one stapled/pinned on the first page of the Performa format.
Gather necessary attachments of certificates in support of date of birth, caste, qualification, experience, identity proof, and self-attested photocopies of all certificates and relevant documents.
Bring the filled application form along with all original certificates and documents to the interview venue on the date of interview.
Attend the interview on 16 October 2026 at 9:00 AM sharply at the Department of Microbiology, 4th Floor, Academic Building, AIIMS, Deoghar.
important_instructions: The above-mentioned vacancy is for a fixed tenure of one year (12 months) and will automatically terminate upon completion of 1 year from the day of joining duties. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The contract can be extended to a maximum of three years depending on the candidate’s performance and budget grant from the funding agency. Candidates have no right to claim permanent employment based on this job. No change in serial no. order and the heading of column is allowed in the application form. No separate communication will be sent to the candidates. Email for correspondence: [email protected]

Bring the filled application form along with all original certificates and documents to the interview venue on the date of interview. faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Deoghar has announced a recruitment notification for 3 contractual posts under the State-Level Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratory (VRDL), Department of Microbiology.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across Scientist-C, Data Entry Operator, and Multi-Tasking Staff posts.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 16 October 2026 at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the AIIMS Deoghar walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Department of Microbiology, 4th Floor, Academic Building, AIIMS, Deoghar.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Scientist-C (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc./M.Sc. MLT in Virology/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Parasitology/M.Tech Biotechnology with 4 years of experience in R&D/Teaching, or 2nd Class in these degrees with a Ph.D. and 4 years of experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years as on or before 30 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Deoghar Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Multi-Tasking Staff?
faq.answer: The Multi-Tasking Staff position carries a consolidated salary of Rs. 18,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely on a contractual basis for a fixed tenure of one year (12 months), extendable up to three years.
